newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar, firms on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar, firms on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened on the dollar but firmed against the pound on Tuesday despite central bank intervention on Monday, commercial dealer said.
The rupee was quoted at a mean commercial rate of 20.0905 against the dollar from 20.0690 on Monday. Against the pound, the rupee was fixed at a mean of 33.5830 from 33.7025 on Monday.
Forex dealers said the central bank sold dollars to banks on Monday with the intervention rate lower than the prevailing interbank rate.

"But the intervention was not sufficient to offset the appreciating dollar in overnight international markets. The net result is that the rupee has depreciated against the dollar today," said one dealer from an international bank.
The dealer added that commercial banks were not short foreign currencies at the moment after regular central bank interventions over the past weeks.
